notes.title: Bug fixes and gameplay changes update
notes.content:
Since the last update, I've been looking at feedback and continuing to playtest to find ways to improve the game before the upcoming content update! 

In this update there were a lot of bug fixes such as:

- Game over event now working properly
- Chase Music bug is now fixed (no longer infinitely playing in multiplayer)
- Save game bug
- Multiplayer menu bug
- Many More!

There were also many adjustments to the gameplay and overall look and feel of the game such as:
- Jumping
- Item counters and icons on the HUD when players pick up objects
- Adjusted cleaning time for the mop (from 20 seconds to 15 seconds)
- Updated visuals (for "ghost trap" ability and player ghost)
- Updated visuals and audio for "ghost drain" ability.

If there are any bugs or glitches you encounter please reach out and let me know about it!

notes.title: November 5, 2024 Update
notes.content:
-Fixed the animation bugs of the ghosts for the client players
-Fixed visual bug for session info menu
-Changed connection meter to ping counter
-Fixed a bug on the "Invite Players" screen
-Adjusted the height of the player ghosts and added a hovering animation
-Fixed bug where the soda drinking sound was not playing for client
-Fixed bugs with the washers
-Washers now also need the power to be on for them to work
-Overall flashlight brightness has been dimmed
-Flashlight's brightness will lower when looking at a close object and will brighten again when not looking at close object.

The next update is already being worked on, more bugs will be fixed and gameplay will continue to be tweaked!
